step1_analysis.description: A single-stage OTA with a dynamically biased Class-AB output stage. The input differential pair drives a low-impedance diode string, which simultaneously drives the gates and dynamically biases the sources of the output push-pull transistors, enabling high slew rate and efficient driving of capacitive loads for ramp generation.

paper_reference.title: On-Chip Ramp Generators for Mixed-Signal BIST and ADC Self-Test

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain ~ gm * Rout. With Id ~ 20uA, gm ~ 200uS, Rout ~ 500kOhm, Gain ~ 100 V/V = 40 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Single-stage topology with low-impedance internal node limits the gain to a single stage's intrinsic gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGBW = gm / (2*pi*CL). With gm ~ 200uS and CL = 10pF, UGBW ~ 3.2 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the bias current and load capacitance. The paper reports 10 MHz, which is achievable with slightly higher bias or smaller load.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dominant pole is at the output. Non-dominant poles are at internal low-impedance nodes (~gm/Cgs).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Load-compensated single-stage OTAs typically have excellent phase margin close to 90 degrees.

slew_rate.description: Maximum rate of change of output voltage

sky130_expected.calculation: Class-AB output allows dynamic current boosting. SR > I_tail / CL.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The dynamic biasing of the output stage sources allows the output current to significantly exceed the quiescent bias current.
Based on the 0.99V bias voltage generating ~40uA in the primary mirror.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, UGBW, phase margin, slew rate, and power consumption of the Class-AB OTA.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Class-AB OTA Testbench

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u

.subckt opamp IN_PLUS IN_MINUS OUT IBIAS VDD VSS GND
XM1 N3 N3 VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N7 N7 N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 OUT N7 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N7 N0 VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 OUT N7 N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N0 N0 VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N7 N7 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N6 N6 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N7 IN_PLUS N8 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N0 IN_MINUS N8 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N8 IBIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N1 N3 VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N4 N6 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 IBIAS IBIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
.ends

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VIBIAS IBIAS 0 0.99

* AC Testbench (Open Loop with DC feedback)
Xac IN_PLUS_AC IN_MINUS_AC OUT_AC IBIAS VDD VSS 0 opamp
Vac IN_PLUS_AC 0 DC 0.9 AC 1
Lac OUT_AC IN_MINUS_AC 1T
Cac IN_MINUS_AC 0 1T
CLac OUT_AC 0 10p

* TRAN Testbench (Unity Gain Buffer)
Xtran IN_PLUS_TRAN OUT_TRAN OUT_TRAN IBIAS VDD VSS 0 opamp
Vtran IN_PLUS_TRAN 0 DC 0.9 PULSE(0.4 1.4 10n 1n 1n 1u 2u)
CLtran OUT_TRAN 0 10p

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

ac dec 100 1 1G
let gain_db = vdb(OUT_AC)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(OUT_AC))
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1
meas ac ugbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_margin find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1
let pm = 180 + phase
meas ac pm_val find pm when gain_db=0 fall=1

tran 1n 3u
meas tran sr_rise_time trig v(OUT_TRAN) val=0.6 rise=1 targ v(OUT_TRAN) val=1.2 rise=1
let sr_r = 0.6 / sr_rise_time
let sr_r_vus = sr_r * 1e-6

meas tran sr_fall_time trig v(OUT_TRAN) val=1.2 fall=1 targ v(OUT_TRAN) val=0.6 fall=1
let sr_f = 0.6 / sr_fall_time
let sr_f_vus = sr_f * 1e-6

print sr_r_vus sr_f_vus
quit
.endc
